id_rules.alignment_id: stable unique string generated from run_id, read_id, alignment class, segment index, coordinates, and CIGAR

critical_semantics: RNA non-observation must never be encoded as absence of a DNA repeat expansion.
SPAN evidence requires both genomic-left and genomic-right unique flank anchors.
Censored evidence is a lower bound, not an exact repeat length.
Sequence evidence and independent-molecule evidence must remain separate.
Primary, secondary, and supplementary alignments must be retained until locus assignment is finalized.
TR and TR_FALLBACK regions use copy-number-first analysis; VC and complex disease regions use sequence-level analysis.

LEFT_ONLY_INTERNAL and RIGHT_ONLY_INTERNAL indicate a target-overlapping repeat tract supported by one genomic flank, without reaching the expected raw-read end; they are neither exact sizes nor censored lower bounds.

alignment_segments.grain: one row per BAM alignment record or segment

columns.name: softclip_left_bp
columns.description: Left soft clip in query orientation.

columns.name: softclip_right_bp
columns.description: Right soft clip in query orientation.

read_evidence.grain: one row per read × target-region × locus hypothesis

columns.name: repeat_bp_lower_bound
columns.description: Lower bound; mandatory for censored evidence.

columns.name: repeat_bp_upper_bound
columns.description: Upper bound; missing for one-sided censored evidence.

repeat_segments.grain: one row per repeat segment or motif component within read evidence

molecule_clusters.grain: one row per inferred original molecule cluster

molecule_membership.grain: one row per evidence row assigned to a molecule cluster

locus_summary.grain: one row per sample × TRExplorer locus

columns.name: rna_evidence_status
columns.description: RNA evidence state; never call no coverage negative.

columns.name: expansion_signal_status
columns.description: Candidate status; absence is not a DNA-negative call.

region_summary.grain: one row per sample × analysis region
